verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents official MCP servers that let AI clients such as Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT access Chargebee capabilities directly. Custom MCP servers can expose subscription and invoice tools, for example an invoice lookup server, and an in-UI AI can answer questions. However, the evidence does not show agent-queryable MRR metrics, delinquent-account lists or upcoming-renewal queries. missing for 10: documented MRR/revenue-metric tools for agents, explicit delinquent-account and upcoming-renewal query tools, independent hands-on corroboration of agent billing Q&A.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can answer questions about my billing state — MRR, delinquent accounts, upcoming renewals, a customer's invoices — by querying the platform directly

citations.quote: Connect AI clients such as Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, and other MCP-compatible tools to Chargebee MCP Servers to securely access selected capabilities.
an invoice lookup server that exposes only the subscription and invoice tools your AI client needs
Use AI inside the Chargebee Billing UI to answer questions and complete tasks.
